title: Hiphop 02
name: hiphop-02
arc:
A hip-hop step-through seen at three-quarter. Weight alternates quickly between feet, character-right then character-left at frame 2 and back, arms bent and out to the side at waist-to-chest height, then the figure centres at frame 4 and steps again with the arm rising to shoulder height by frame 8.

Pingpong: frames 0 and 20 are the turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight on the character-right foot, character-left foot lifted. character-left knee slightly bent, character-right knee slightly bent. character-left arm at waist height, elbow slightly bent, out to the side. character-right arm at waist height, elbow bent ~90°, by the side. torso upright. character-right hip raised. character-right shoulder raised. head turned character-left.
